# Vireek

> Vireek is an AI voice receptionist for home-service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, restoration, locksmith). Its receptionist, "Sarah", answers calls, captures lead details and books jobs. Vireek is an early-stage, founder-led company and publishes no customer counts.

## Product and pricing
- [Pricing](https://vireek.com/pricing): plans from Free to Enterprise, monthly or annual billing
- [Integrations](https://vireek.com/integrations): supported third-party integrations
- [Help center](https://vireek.com/help): how-to guides and answers
